description: Department of Fiscal Policy - Order to amend the Gaz. Ex. No. 2047/02 adding Sub Paragraph on Export Oriented enterprises
categorisation: This gazette content primarily involves the amendment of an existing legal order under the Sri Lanka Export Development Act, No. 40 of 1979. It contains regulatory changes to import/export rules, specifically modifying tariff rates and adding new categories for raw materials and components. The content focuses on legal/regulatory framework modifications rather than government personnel, organizational structure, or other specialized categories.
